subject: NEW_TOPIC_AURORA_TIDE_GAUGE
subject_note: A deliberately unfamiliar subject (an aurora tide-gauge readout) used to exercise 'new subject, unclear hierarchy' without relying on any known painter style.

flicker.constraint: <=3 Hz for every flashing element; there are none.

salience_formula: salience = round(0.45*min(contrast_ratio,7)/7 + 0.25*font_weight/700 + 0.30*(1-area_fraction), 2); accent adds +0.10 cap 1.0 — declared design values, NOT perceptual measurement

role_based.description: Semantic roles own salience slots per N3 axis-ownership; data value gets the single top-salience slot.

pure_style.description: Identical style vocabulary, but illustration owns the top slot. This is the counter-example that must fail the role check.

contrast_prediction.held_constant: palette, typeface, spacing scale, slot salience numbers
contrast_prediction.claim_scope: Mechanical/declared contrast under constant style. NOT a human reading test, NOT an aesthetic verdict, NOT a rendered-image comparison.

verification_anchor.definition: One frame, one headline; present verbatim in the readable_data_value slot of both variants.
verification_anchor.source_pattern: structure.md L15-19 (收尾文案 = one-frame verification anchor)

provenance.mechanism_source: knowledge/CAPABILITIES.json roktim___ mechanism_summary (annotation roles); conflicts.md N3/N4/N8 (axis ownership / separable object classes / per-layer budget)
provenance.note: All numbers are [design declaration]/[inference], unmeasured; see unaided-selection.json still_missing_evidence.
